text: Code reviews are an important practice in software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the software reaches users. This saves time and money because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also help with knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project better. As a result, the whole team improves its quality. Everyone benefits from shared responsibility and fewer mistakes. In short, code reviews are not just about finding errors; they help build a stronger, more skilled team.
